notes.title: Small graphical update and bug fix
notes.content:
In this latest update we have enabled the casting of shadows from the sun/moon which should make the game look a bit less static. Due to the game being made for standalone the steam version has taken a hit in terms of graphics but we are trying to find ways to re-enable parts of the rendering system without causing huge optimisation problems. 

Fixed a bug where players were spawning in halfway through the first level.

notes.title: Significant Updates For Full Release Venture's Gauntlet
notes.content:
[b]This update pushes Venture's Gauntlet to full release[/b]

[previewyoutube=DOm33dQ4vBU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*]Two New Maps: A new ObstaCorp Hub World and Stage 9 for a grand finale.  
[*]Incredible new slow motion mechanic for nailing dramatic jumps and avoiding turret blasts.
[*]Improvements to turret gunners with new detection/voice system.
[*]New story featuring Adam Venture, the crazy billionaire behind ObstaCorp and Venture's Gauntlet
[*]More checkpoints added and maps split into nine stages of 15 mins length each.
[*]Polish Improvements on climbing, archery, ziplines, shield summoning, and more.
[*]Cross platform leaderboard update for playing with friends and doing competitions.
[*]Improved Tutorial and full EFIGS+ JA/KO/ZH localization options
[/list]

We will be pushing another update this week with some PC VR specific graphics improvements to turn back on shadows and boost the graphics level higher.  In the future we hope to make some more new PC VR specific maps as well where we can really push the graphics, that is our dream as game devs.  

Huge thank you to the PCVR community who supported our early access release, we hope to continue to support this title and add more content as it's been our dream to make the most intense obstacle course experience you can have in VR!

notes.content:

The issue was that some calibration settings made it so that the ramp into a rope climb configuration was inacessible.

We added a small rope beforehand and slightly adjusted the aftermentioned ramp to avoid blocking progression.

notes.title: First Major Update!
notes.content:
This is our first major update in store for Venture's Gauntlet VR! ːsteamhappyː

The focus of this update is as shown both the Online Leaderboards and Fitness Tracking, you can see the attached image for a rundown of the new additions of today's update.

At the end of each stage you will now see a pop up that will tell you not only how your stats looked like during this run but also how you fared either against your friends or on the global and weekly leaderboards!

The pause menu had some more QOL features added to it! You can check up on your stats, acess the fast travel menu, new audio settings and an exit game button.

Some more polish was added into the game and the main focus was improving the start and end of each stage.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756214/828743e9a1978c14d1eaa5eb0aed69327a8937fa.png[/img]




*Calorie tracking is only an estimate using our own tracked data (as in, while we playtest).
We will attempt to refine it down the line.

Join our Discord server to share your feedback, get news of any updates and be along with the rest of all our Venturers: https://discord.gg/3JBcAj94Tc
Thank you for supporting our game; we look forward to hearing from you!

- BearHammer Games

notes.title: General improvements to levels
notes.content:
Today's update mostly focus on fixing map bugs, respawn issues, aiming to improve general flow and polish.

Changes: 

[list]
[*] Indoor areas should now be rain free. 
[*] Some obstacles can't be walked upon (swings, monkey bars).
[*] General light fixes for night time scenarios.
[*] Adjusted glow on non hostile archery targets.
[*] Shields have now discovered gravity.

[*] Section 3:
[list]

[*] Fix on lasers stopping too soon on initial moving platform.
[*] Fix on circular lasers on climbing section incorrectly respawning the player.
[/list]
[*] Section 4:
[list]

[*] Improved polish on initial playable area (fixed animation on rotating walls).
[*] Fixed possible issue with getting stuck on the double swings.
[*] Fixed floating ropes.
[*] General improvements to flow in first zipline area + zipline won't first go backwards.
[*] Adjusted loading of next area on the archery section, pop in should be less noticeable.
[/list]
[*] Section 6:
[list]

[*] Slight tweaks on courtyard area (this will be an ongoing process).
[/list]
[/list]

We have been listening to all the coming feedback and bugs that have been reported, thank you for all the help you have been giving. 
Expect general QOL, bugfixes and polish changes on smaller patches as we strive to launch a bigger update down the road ^^

Join our Discord server to share your feedback and get news of any updates and closed gameplay testing: https://discord.gg/3JBcAj94Tc
Thank you for supporting our game; we look forward to hearing from you!

- BearHammer Games

notes.content:

[*] New Time of Day and Weather System, experience rain, night time, moving clouds, and dynamic light making the experience more beautiful than ever.

[*] Archery improvements: Includes a new bow that makes aiming easier

notes.title: NEW DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We are excited to bring you the new updated demo for Adventure Fitness VR!

In this update, we are introducing:
[list]
[*]A brand new map (The highlands)
[*]Improved gameplay features, with more obstacles and puzzles to solve!
[*]Updated running mechanics
[*]Improved graphics and sounds
[*]New UI and a "pause" menu
[*]A calibration system that adjusts the height and width of the obstacles to fit each player
[*]Brand new ARCHERY mechanic and challenge
[*]Brand new CRANK/ROW mechanic
[*]And much, much more!
[/list]

We are excited to hear your thoughts on the updates and the new features!
We will continue to add new features to the Demo over the coming weeks, such as leaderboards!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
Updating the demo with a calibration map so players can calibrate climbing obstacles to be customized to their height and arm length.

Updating also to add a menu button & menu system that can be activated to restart the demo or change foliage density.  

Small updates to collision volumes & checkpoint system for restarting sections after falling.
